answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 7745 Country: India Title: Is kissing and hugging with wife allowed during the period of fasting? Is there any provision for sex in between Iftaar and Sahri with wife? Question: Is kissing and hugging with wife allowed during the period of fasting? Is there any provision for sex in between Iftaar and Sahri with wife? Answer ID: 7745 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 995/995=M/1429) One is allowed to have kissing and hugging if he has control over himself, but it is better for a youth to avoid such things as these things may lead to intercourse. (2) It is allowed to have intercourse between iftar and sahr , there is no precondition for the same. However, one should not miss salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
